Coram : DEEPAK GUPTA*, ANIRUDDHA BOSE
Central Excise Tariff Act, 1985 – First Schedule- Chapters 57, 87 – Car mats to be classified under chapter-heading 57.03 or 87.08 – Respondent-assessee was engaged in business of manufacture of textile floor coverings and car matting – Cleared goods against which inter alia had excise duty @ 8% as compared to 16% if classified under heading 8708.99.00 – Three show-cause notices issued over such clearance of goods – Commissioner held car mattings to be parts and accessories classifiable under Chapter 87.08 – Tribunal decided in
Decision Date : 01-05-2020 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 302/2009 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
